name: website_info
title: Website Info
summary: Copyright line plus a project-info icon that opens the site dates and the project's technologies.
description: Footer copyright line, the cookie settings icon and a project-info icon that opens a small popover. Nothing of it is printed in the HTML: website_info.js fetches data_content_project_info.json and, when it sets "project", that entry from post/data_post_project.json (current language, default language as fallback) when the popover opens, so changing a date or a technology needs no re-render. "dates": { text, field } reads data.date.<field> of the project ("In progress" shows in_progress_text), { text, date } a fixed date or "current-date" (the page's last-modified time = last deploy). "groups": { text, field } lists the project's { svg, text } items at that path (web.technology, web.platform, web.tools, web.ai_tools); "items_display": both | icon | text. Icons are loaded from src/content/svg/.
